correctness.how: A deterministic runner builds the pinned shared-content fixture, checks independently declared source text and section coverage, invokes the PPTX structural validator, and proves the validator rejects seven corrupted-package cases.

cost.note: This runner has no model session, so it must not turn local build time into token or dollar figures.

time.note: Harness duration is a machine-speed measurement, not agent elapsed time or time saved.

with-skills.note: The deterministic runner exercises the shipped compose-deliverable renderer and validators against a pinned fixture.

baseline-no-skills.note: A real model-driven comparison must run the same source fixture, host, model, and prompt with the Ascent skills withheld. The deterministic runner cannot construct that control by calling the renderer directly.

consistency.note: The runner can repeat correctness checks, but cost consistency remains unknown until at least three recorded agent runs exist in each arm.

coverage.rationale: Protect the shipped renderer and structural gates as regression behavior while establishing the first document-output capability evaluation.

trials.rationale: The local fixture and structural checks are deterministic. Whole-suite repeats are exposed through --runs for the workbench.

graders.rationale: Independent required text and section counts check source-to-PPTX mapping.
OOXML structure, native editability, brand tokens, notes, and image relationships are objectively inspectable.

skills_invoked.note: The deterministic harness invokes scripts, not an agent session.

required: Confirm the approved source content artifact.
Confirm the deck title, classification, accent, and slide sequence.
clarifying_questions.note: The deterministic harness has no user turn.
